speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Sit, if thou art sitting. I have already had one door-talk, and I am not having the hall become a second one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sat. I have a few things left in the day, and I am not spending them on company.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: I am going up. The hall is clear. It can keep what is left without me standing over it.
